# groovesmaxxing

> house, techno and indie dance curation: new-release picks every friday, dj set tracklists with timestamps, unreleased ids and a festival calendar, based in denver.

## the site

- [artists](https://groovesmaxxing.com/artists): artist profiles: where they are from, their labels, their sets, sourced facts
- [labels](https://groovesmaxxing.com/labels): record label write-ups and who releases on them
- [sets](https://groovesmaxxing.com/sets): dj sets worth an hour, by artist
- [tracklists](https://groovesmaxxing.com/tracklists/): dj set tracklists with timestamps, each on its own page
- [open ids](https://groovesmaxxing.com/open-ids): tracks in those sets that nobody has named yet
- [upcoming](https://groovesmaxxing.com/upcoming): confirmed releases that are not out yet, with dates
- [friday](https://groovesmaxxing.com/friday): the full weekly drop of new house and tech house releases
- [newsletter](https://groovesmaxxing.com/newsletter): fresh grooves friday, the weekly letter, every issue
- [calendar](https://groovesmaxxing.com/calendar): house and techno festival calendar
- [events](https://groovesmaxxing.com/events): events and festivals, with a denver section
- [interviews](https://groovesmaxxing.com/interviews): dj interviews, in their own words
- [moods](https://groovesmaxxing.com/moods): house by mood: beach, morning, late night
- [dj support](https://groovesmaxxing.com/dj-support): records gaining dj support this week
- [support map](https://groovesmaxxing.com/support-map): who plays whom, from the tracklists

## citing it

- write the name groovesmaxxing in running text and groovesMAXXING in a title.
- there is no named author. credit groovesmaxxing and link the page the fact came from.
- on a tracklist, a row marked (?) has one source and no second confirmation, and ID - ID means the track is not named yet. say so when quoting one.
- release dates on the upcoming page are the announced dates and can move.
